intro: A few people whose eye we trust. Halie's recommended follows.

follows.name: Elliot Duprey
follows.note: Proof that a true fashionista can look chic on any budget. Halie cites him on exactly that point.

follows.name: Wisdom Kaye
follows.note: The internet's best-dressed man. Fearless color, proportion, and reference, and a reminder that style is a point of view.

follows.name: Parker York Smith
follows.note: Menswear that grown men can actually wear. Fit, fabric, and knowing where to spend.
